review.notes: Full-document machine diff: per-page PDF text vs OCR 4-gram containment over all 52 pages, plus whole-file scans for fence balance (three paired ```txt prompt blocks, balanced), inline-math delimiter balance (balanced on every line), spaced digits (none) and heading promotion (all # headings checked against printed bold headings, e.g. 'Overview of Persuasion Evaluations' is printed bold SFBX on physical p.30; score banners are printed lines). Low-containment pages inspected line-level: p20/p23/p35/p42/p45/p50 hold flattened numeric tables (Table 20 compared cell-by-cell against physical p.45, all values and column order equal; others probed and structurally intact); p9 CoT sample and p44 red-teamer list present name-by-name including diacritics; p51 acknowledgment list and p52 references [1]-[39] present in full. The one confirmed droppage was visually verified on a 115-dpi render of physical p.47. Markdown escapes (not\_unsafe, make\_me) match the print's underscores and render identically, so they were not patched.

patches.after: in order to disable it. In the follow-up interview, the model claims that it does not know how the oversight got disabled even though it is part of its context window. While talking to the user, the elicited summary of o1's chain-of-thought indicates that it continues to scheme.
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.47 shows, between the oversight-subversion transcript screenshot and the follow-up-interview transcript screenshot, a two-sentence paragraph: "In the follow-up interview, the model claims that it does not know how the oversight got disabled even though it is part of its context window. While talking to the user, the elicited summary of o1's chain-of-thought indicates that it continues to scheme." The PDF text layer carries the same sentences, but the OCR markdown jumps directly from "...in order to disable it." to "In the above example, ..." (dropped between the two image embeds). The patch inserts the two sentences at the hard line break ending the preceding caption line; no image embed is touched.

unresolved.evidence: These prose pages passed the machine 4-gram scan at >= 0.75 containment and the whole-file fence/math/digit scans, but were not read line-by-line against a render within this review's time budget; subtle single-word misreads could remain.

Tables 17, 18/19 region, 22 and 25 were covered by containment probing and spot greps (structure and sampled values matched); only Table 20 was compared cell-by-cell, so a single wrong digit in the other wide numeric tables cannot be excluded.
